title: Enhancing student performance prediction using an optimized RNN-LSTM model: a step towards personalized education
reason: LSTM student-performance prediction evaluated only on a synthetic dataset of 720 generated records; no data from real students or a real LMS, so no empirical indicator-outcome relation.
